purpose.text: Accept, track and settle customer orders through to fulfilment handover.

roles.text: Execution — runs the ordering workflow end to end
Gateway — the single front door for storefront orders

language.text: Order — a customer's committed intent to buy
Line — one product at one quantity within an order

decisions.text: An order is only confirmed once stock is reserved and payment is authorised.
Cancellation is free until the fulfilment handover, chargeable after.

assumptions.text: Inventory reservations are authoritative and never oversell.
Payments settles within the same business day.

metrics.text: Confirmed-to-handover latency under 5 minutes at p95

questions.text: Who owns partial refunds — this context or Billing?
Does a split shipment produce one order or two?
